regime_context: The detector shows Memory, HBM & Storage as the leading narrative with mixed trend health. The absolute-trend gate—the only validated edge—is active (gate_helps true), letting eligible themes benefit from risk-controlled drawdown avoidance. Rotation breadth is broad (72% eligible) but no single narrative dominates; momentum ranks are an attention lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Monitor for a confirmed handoff: if Memory storage loses eligibility while Cybersecurity maintains trend health and its crowding z drops below ~1.5, consider re-evaluating the leading narrative.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Leading theme, trend-eligible, and not crowded. The validated absolute-trend gate supports owning it as long as it remains eligible, because the gate has historically cut drawdown when themes stay eligible. Overweight relative to ineligible or dangerously crowded themes.
evidence: gate_helps true (trend gate reduces drawdown for eligible themes)
theses.dissent: Durability bar is modest (0.48) and hurst_tag 'mixed' signals fragile trend health; a quick breakdown could flip eligibility and trigger a sharp reversal.

falsifier.text: If Memory, HBM & Storage loses trend eligibility (flips to ineligible) within the next 20 days, the overweight thesis is invalid.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Ranked #2 but dangerously crowded (crowding_z 2.27). Crowding is a size-down caution—risk/reward is skewed negatively at these extremes. Underweight until positioning normalizes, acknowledging it is not the dominant narrative so a fade is permissible but conviction remains low.
evidence: guardrails: crowding reduces size; fading not forbidden as it is not the dominant theme
theses.dissent: Strong trend and high durability could drive further performance despite crowding; if AI tailwinds broaden, a squeeze might accelerate.

falsifier.text: If Cybersecurity’s relative strength continues to expand for the next 20 trading days without a drawdown, and crowding z remains above 2, the underweight thesis is invalid.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Ranked 4th but crowded (z=1.77). Crowding warrants caution, favoring a reduce/avoid stance over overweight. Risk/reward is less favorable than uncrowded leaders.
theses.dissent: A defensive rotation amid macro uncertainty could sustain the trend regardless of crowding, negating the underweight edge.

falsifier.text: If Managed Care & Insurers posts positive returns over the next 20 days without a crowding-driven reversal, the underweight call is wrong.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
